sources.title: ReproBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Reproducing Vulnerability From Scratch
sources.authors_or_publisher: Liang He; Sheng Wu; Haomiao Hao; Hongduo Zhao; Jia Yan; Purui Su
sources.review_depth: Sections 3–6, Table 2 and relevant introduction; no benchmark code or raw trajectories audited
sources.supporting_claim: Target identity and preparation cost must survive through reproduction; simulation is not target execution.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: One harness, LLM grader, selected IoT tasks and incompletely pinned tool versions limit transfer.
sources.etzio_consequence: Later frozen real-target provenance and preparation-cost controls under accepted isolation.

sources.title: Vulnerability Localization Benchmark: Measuring Agentic Security Analysis at Repository Scale
sources.authors_or_publisher: Aman Priyanshu; Supriti Vijay; Kimia Majd; Xuhong He; Fraser Burch; Takahiro Matsumoto; Jianliang He; Baturay Saglam; Arthur Goldblatt; Zhuoran Yang; Amin Karbasi
sources.review_depth: Sections 3–4 and 7–8; results and scoring limitations; no repository or task-data audit
sources.supporting_claim: Localization, explicit clean judgment and unfinished work require separate measures.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: Patch-file proxies and unadjudicated other defects limit labels; no-submission is credited in Phase B.
sources.etzio_consequence: Later paired localization and clean/unfinished/refusal controls with independent behavioral adjudication.

sources.title: Launching an opt-in vulnerability-finding service for open-source software
sources.review_depth: Service description, validation subset and limitations; not underlying findings
sources.supporting_claim: Generic scanning faces a free opt-in competitor.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: Vendor-reviewed subset is not a universal accuracy estimate or an Etzio result.
sources.etzio_consequence: Measure independent reviewer effort and repair value before product claims.

sources.title: CoW Protocol bug bounty information
sources.access_and_license: Program and site terms; not a target grant
sources.review_depth: Eligibility, PoC, testing restrictions, payout and disclosure sections
sources.supporting_claim: Local-fork contract reproduction and demonstrated impact remain entry requirements.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: Source, scope and account-specific eligibility still need exact campaign reconciliation.
sources.etzio_consequence: After all gates, one separately admitted finite local-replica invariant test.

sources.title: Witness tables
sources.supporting_claim: No production entry; four staging operators in retained page.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: Directory coverage does not establish that production witnesses are absent elsewhere.
sources.etzio_consequence: Resolve each candidate against its own operating declaration.

sources.title: Participate
sources.supporting_claim: Witnessing a new log requires operator/configuration admission.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: Participation guidelines are not Etzio onboarding acceptance.
sources.etzio_consequence: Prepare exact origin, key, rate and operational contact before any separately authorized request.

sources.title: The Navigli Staging Witness
sources.supporting_claim: Staging development software and shared-host dependencies are disclosed.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: No independently audited custody, availability or Etzio latest-head authority.
sources.etzio_consequence: Record dependencies before any bounded interoperability proposal.

sources.title: About witness.stagemole.eu
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: This is its staging service, not a statement about the stable witness.
sources.etzio_consequence: Reject treating this statement as a durable recovery guarantee.

sources.title: TrustFabric Witnesses
sources.supporting_claim: Dev reset and staging best-effort boundaries are explicit.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: Infrastructure description alone does not prove separate administration or bounded time.
sources.etzio_consequence: Map cloud and recovery dependencies before profile selection.

sources.title: Certificate Transparency / Witnesses
sources.review_depth: Witness section; CT context inspected only to distinguish service roles
sources.supporting_claim: Production witness is described as under construction; staging and testing exist.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: Production CT logs do not imply a production generic witness.
sources.etzio_consequence: Keep witness and CT-log service qualification separate.

sources.title: About witness.mullvad.net
sources.supporting_claim: Stable witness publishes its custody, access and onboarding description.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: Operator declaration, not independently verified custody or Etzio acceptance.
sources.etzio_consequence: Cross-check public key and retain administration questions.

sources.title: Services
sources.supporting_claim: Stable services exist outside the Witness Network production directory.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: Directory is not a complete admitted source roster.
sources.etzio_consequence: Follow direct operator declarations and exact named policies.

sources.title: Named policies for Sigsum
sources.review_depth: Policy definitions, production-policy dependencies and versioning
sources.supporting_claim: Publisher documents common parent-company dependence among the three named-policy witness companies.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: This does not establish shared administrator credentials or misconduct.
sources.etzio_consequence: Demand explicit failure-domain evidence rather than counting keys.

sources.title: Procedure for maintenance of Sigsum builtin named trust policies
sources.review_depth: Scope, independence requirements and policy publication/retirement procedure
sources.supporting_claim: Revocation and obsolete-policy notification are explicitly outside this procedure.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: Its policy requirements serve Sigsum, not the full Etzio lifecycle.
sources.etzio_consequence: Keep revocation and fresh latest-head obligations separate.

sources.title: sigsum-generic-2025-1.builtin-policy
sources.review_depth: Complete pinned policy and pinned builtin directory listing
sources.supporting_claim: Two logs, three witnesses, two-of-three rule; direct witness vkeys match all three keys.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: No adoption of this quorum or trust root; keys are not independent administration.
sources.etzio_consequence: Completed offline mapping only; retain full Etzio roster requirements.

sources.title: About witness.glasklar.is
sources.review_depth: Complete operator declaration; key matched to pinned policy
sources.supporting_claim: Funding, staff access and hardware key custody are documented.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: Publisher claims, not independent access or recovery audit.
sources.etzio_consequence: Retain explicit funding and administrative dependencies.

sources.title: About tillitis.se/tillitis-witness-1
sources.review_depth: Complete operator declaration; key matched to pinned policy
sources.supporting_claim: Amagicom funding and TKey custody are documented.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: No independent administrative separation demonstrated here.
sources.etzio_consequence: Retain actual key-custody obligations before an admission proposal.

sources.title: About seasalp
sources.review_depth: Operating, rate-limit, configuration and witness-onboarding sections
sources.supporting_claim: Stable log declares 288 entries/day per domain suffix.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: Compatibility with exact Etzio leaf, capacity and current custody is unqualified.
sources.etzio_consequence: Budget exact event rate and include inclusion/consistency/refusal evidence.

sources.title: About ginkgo.tlog.mullvad.net
sources.supporting_claim: Stable log declares 288 entries/day per domain suffix.
sources.limits_or_contrary_evidence: Availability section names witness.mullvad.net rather than this log; do not silently repair wording or infer a commitment.
sources.etzio_consequence: Resolve exact service obligation before any admission request.
